Method of Attack: Backdoored with malicious code to allow unauthorized remote access
Obfuscated build process extracts a prebuilt object file to modify liblzma functions
Interferes with sshd daemon process to break SSH authentication and gain unauthorized access
Impacted Systems: Arch Linux (installation medium 2024.03.01, virtual machine images 20240301.218094 and 20240315.221711, and container images created between 2024-02-24 and 2024-03-28)
Debian testing, unstable, and experimental versions (from 5.5.1alpha-0.1 to 5.6.1-1)
Attack Vector: Injection of malicious code into OpenSSH server (SSHD) to execute arbitrary payloads before authentication
Hijacking victim machines via SSH using a specific private key
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious commits to Tukaani Project repository by user 'Jia Tan (JiaT75)'
Heavily obfuscated code in liblzma build process
